{{Quote|We have Rebel scum bolting from their hole! Stop them, Mu 1!|Imperial Officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''''Weet''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

'''Weet''' was a transport containing [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] hiding inside a Rebel [[Class-D cargo container]] [[Pi (Class-D cargo container)|''Pi'']], surrounded by [[Mine Type A|Type A mines]]. The minefield was cleared by a single [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]], [[Mu 1]], and was inspected to see what was hiding inside. The transport was then launched from the container and attempted to escape, only to be disabled by the Gunboat. [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft|System Patrol Craft]] [[Scythis (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Scythis'']] then boarded the transport and captured it.

The event was recorded and used to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] on how to use a Gunboat. One of those pilots was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
